lessons.title: How much is it?
lessons.goal_uz: Narx so'raysiz, raqamlarni tushunasiz va this / that / these / those bilan narsalarni ko'rsatasiz.

words.ex: I want to buy a T-shirt.
Here you are. That's five pounds.

steps.body_uz:
Eng ko'p adashtiriladigan raqamlar: **thirteen (13)** va **thirty (30)**, **fifteen (15)** va **fifty (50)**.
-**teen** so'zlarida urg'u oxirida: thir**TEEN**. -**ty** so'zlarida urg'u boshida: **THIR**ty.
Narx aytish: £4.50 = "four pounds fifty", $12 = "twelve dollars".

steps.title: At a clothes shop
steps.context_uz: Ozoda Londondagi kiyim do'konida futbolka sotib olmoqda.

lines.en: Yes, please. How much is this T-shirt?
lines.uz: Ha, iltimos. Bu futbolka qancha turadi?

lines.en: Fifteen — one, five. And these T-shirts are only ten pounds.
lines.uz: O'n besh — bir, besh. Manavi futbolkalar esa atigi o'n funt.

lines.en: Oh, they're cheap! Do you have this one in a medium size?
lines.uz: Voy, arzon ekan! Shunisining o'rtacha o'lchami bormi?

lines.en: Great, I'll take it. Can I pay by card?
lines.uz: Zo'r, olaman. Karta bilan to'lasam bo'ladimi?

steps.q: How much is the first T-shirt?

steps.body_uz:
Narsani ko'rsatish uchun:
**this** — bu (yaqin, bitta) · **that** — u, anavi (uzoq, bitta)
**these** — bular (yaqin, ko'p) · **those** — ular, anavilar (uzoq, ko'p)
Ko'plikda fe'l ham o'zgaradi: **This is** cheap. → **These are** cheap.
Narx so'rash: **How much is** this? · **How much are** these?

steps.q: (Uzoqdagi ikki do'konni ko'rsatib) ___ shops are new.

steps.text: Excuse me, how much is this T-shirt?

steps.prompt_uz: Do'konda sotuvchi bilan qisqa dialog yozing (4–6 gap): narx so'rang, o'lcham so'rang va qanday to'lashni ayting.
steps.prompt: Write a short dialogue in a shop: ask the price, ask for a size and say how you will pay.
steps.example: Me: Excuse me, how much is this jacket? Assistant: It's forty pounds. Me: Do you have it in a small size? Assistant: Yes, here you are. Me: Thank you. Can I pay by card? Assistant: Of course.

lessons.title: My home
lessons.goal_uz: Uyingizni tasvirlaysiz: there is / there are va in, on, under, next to.

words.ex: We live in a flat on the fifth floor.
My mother is in the kitchen.
There's a big sofa in the living room.
The bathroom is next to my bedroom.
My desk is near the window.
The cat is under the bed.
Our flat is on the third floor.

steps.title: Bobur's flat
steps.text: I live with my parents in a flat in Tashkent. It's on the fourth floor. There are three bedrooms, a kitchen, a living room and a bathroom. My bedroom is small, but I love it. There's a bed, a desk and a big window. There are a lot of books on my desk! The kitchen is my mother's favourite room. There's a big table in the kitchen, and we have breakfast there every morning. There isn't a garden, but there's a nice balcony with flowers.
steps.uz: Men ota-onam bilan Toshkentdagi kvartirada yashayman. U to'rtinchi qavatda. Uchta yotoqxona, oshxona, mehmonxona va hammom bor. Mening xonam kichik, lekin men uni yaxshi ko'raman. Unda karavot, stol va katta deraza bor. Stolimda ko'p kitob bor! Oshxona — onamning eng sevimli xonasi. Oshxonada katta stol bor, biz har kuni ertalab o'sha yerda nonushta qilamiz. Bog' yo'q, lekin gulli chiroyli balkon bor.

steps.explain_uz: "There isn't a garden, but there's a nice balcony".

steps.body_uz:
O'zbekcha "Xonada stol **bor**" — inglizcha **There is** a table in the room.
**There is** (There's) + bitta narsa · **There are** + ko'p narsa.
Inkor: There **isn't** a garden. · There **aren't** any chairs.
So'roq: **Is there** a lift? — Yes, there is. · **Are there** any shops near here?
Joy: **in** (ichida) · **on** (ustida) · **under** (ostida) · **next to** (yonida).

examples.en: There's a sofa in the living room.
There are two windows in my room.
There isn't a lift in our building.
Is there a park near your house?

steps.text: I live in a flat. There are three bedrooms and a big kitchen.

steps.prompt_uz: Uyingiz yoki xonangizni 4–5 gapda tasvirlang. there is / there are va in, on, next to ishlating.
steps.prompt: Describe your home or your room. Use there is / there are and in, on, next to.
steps.example: I live in a house with a small garden. There are four rooms. My room is next to the kitchen. There is a bed, a wardrobe and a desk in my room. There are some photos on the wall. I like my room because it is quiet.

lessons.title: I love it!
lessons.goal_uz: Qiziqishlaringiz haqida gapirasiz: like / love / don't like / hate + -ing va Do you like...?

words.ex: What do you do in your free time?
I think this film is boring.

steps.title: What do you do in your free time?
steps.context_uz: Ikki yangi do'st — Shoxrux va Lucy — qiziqishlari haqida gaplashmoqda.

lines.en: What do you do in your free time, Shokhrukh?
I love playing football. I play with my friends every weekend.
lines.uz: Futbol o'ynashni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Har dam olish kuni do'stlarim bilan o'ynayman.

lines.en: Cool! I don't like football, but I like watching tennis.
lines.uz: Zo'r! Men futbolni yoqtirmayman, lekin tennis tomosha qilishni yoqtiraman.

lines.en: Yes, I do! I love cooking Italian food. What's your favourite food?
lines.uz: Ha! Italyan taomlarini pishirishni juda yaxshi ko'raman. Sening sevimli taoming nima?

lines.en: Plov, of course! But I hate washing the dishes after dinner.
lines.uz: Albatta palov! Lekin kechki ovqatdan keyin idish yuvishni yomon ko'raman.

steps.q_uz: Shoxrux nima qilishni juda yaxshi ko'radi?

steps.body_uz:
His-tuyg'u darajasi: **love** ❤️❤️ · **like** ❤️ · **don't like** 👎 · **hate** 👎👎
Bu fe'llardan keyin ish-harakat **-ing** bilan keladi: I like **playing**. She loves **cooking**. ("I like play" — xato!)
Ot bilan: I like **music**. I don't like **coffee**.
So'roq: **Do you like** swimming? — Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
he/she uchun: She **likes** · Does he **like**...?

examples.en: My sister hates cleaning her room.

steps.text: She ___ cooking. She cooks every day! (❤️❤️)
steps.uz: U ovqat pishirishni juda yaxshi ko'radi.

steps.text: Do you like dancing? — No, I ___.

steps.q: What does the speaker NOT like?
steps.say: I love drawing and I like swimming, but I don't like running.

steps.prompt_uz: Qiziqishlaringiz haqida 4–5 gap yozing: nimani juda yaxshi ko'rasiz, nimani yoqtirasiz, nimani yomon ko'rasiz.
steps.prompt: Write about what you love, like, don't like and hate doing.
steps.example: In my free time I love drawing. I also like watching films with my family. I don't like playing computer games because they are boring for me. I hate cleaning my room, but I do it every Saturday. My favourite day is Sunday.
